title: Owned by and Managed by are the same person
cardHint: Owned by and Managed by name the same person. They should be two different people.

message.subject: Same person as owner and manager
message.intro: The same person is Owned by and Managed by.
message.ask: Could you name a second person for Managed by? You can reply, or raise the request {request:managed-by-update}.
message.why: The two roles approve changes together. One person in both means there is no second check.
message.epoAsk: Could you name a second person as Primary Responsible (Managed by) in EPO?

askByTeam.process-management: Could you name a second person for Managed by? Please {reply} with the name for each process, and we will update ServiceNow.
